urdf_units: ROS-required SI: m, kg, kg*m^2, rad. Engineering data is separately preserved in g/mm/g*mm^2.
scope: Static/numeric simulation inputs configured; ROS and Isaac runtime pending. Physical parameters remain estimates.
gripper: Equivalent opposite linear finger motion with right=-left mimic; internal crank linkage and motor-angle-to-gap mapping not simulated.
arm_limits: Previous sign-corrected reference intervals, not calibrated hardware stops.
actuator_effort_velocity: Manufacturer 11.1V stall torque: peak envelope, NOT continuous/thermal safe rating. Arm 3800N*mm, wheels2700N*mm; fingers10N provisional. Velocities/damping provisional.

collision.limitations: Simplified approximate contacts; tiny fasteners/internal geometry omitted. Runtime collision filtering and grasp clearance require validation.

scripts: simulation_audit.py audits the current package. Baseline finalizer is guarded to prevent reverting simulation inputs.
